200.description: One page of the matching assignments.

destinationPostalPrefix.description: The postal prefix of the destination (from CustomerOrderPlaced); never an address.

witnessNodeId.description: The node of the promise's witness path; the assigned node may differ.

revisionNo.description: The promise revision applied (0 until delivery-promise revises it, gap G13). Node exclusions reset when it changes.

listingId.description: The listing of the released node; absent while QUEUED.

ownerRef.description: The seller (sellerId) whose stock the released line takes, chosen by the OwnerChoice rule at the released node (ADR 0012). Absent while QUEUED and when the line is operator-owned.

pickupCutoffAt.description: The pickup departure's cutoff at this node; the requiredShipBy of a release.

legs.description: Departure ids after the pickup, in travel order.

cost.description: AssignmentCost in cost points (ADR 0002, A12); the legacy ordinal tie-break score (ADR 0011).

estimatedCostCents.description: The money-denominated AssignmentCost estimate of the path in planner-declared cents: the per-unit lane costs of every leg plus the final wave's per-stop cost (ADR 0011). Optional: absent when the estimate is incomplete (a lane or the wave had no declared cost).

candidate.description: The current best candidate; absent when none meets deliverByLatest (UNSOURCEABLE) or the assignment is CANCELLED.

releaseAt.description: VirtualQueue release point (best candidate's pickup cutoff - node handling time - vendor ack budget); present while QUEUED.

reasonCode.description: Present when the node rejected (the vendor's reason code).

pickupDepartureId.description: The pickup departure of the locked path; follows BookingMoved.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

400.description: invalid-limit (limit is not an integer in 1..500), invalid-cursor (the cursor does not decode) or unknown-query-parameter (any query parameter other than state, nodeId, orderId, limit, cursor), or malformed-request (a NUL character in the query string).

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

405.description: method-not-allowed, the method is not served on this path.

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

422.description: validation-failed (ErrValidation), a state query parameter that is not an assignment state.

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

500.description: internal-error, an unexpected failure (the detail never carries the internal message).
